allowed: analytic Hermite mean columns computed from the predicted state
antithetic synthetic-network Monte Carlo used only as a small-n reference
forbidden: any fitted coefficient, target-derived selection, or target-derived tape
scope.promotion_scope: algebraic and frozen small-n discriminator only; this receipt cannot authorize a development-target run

hypotheses.primary: The endpoint mean error contains a systematic leading finite-width contribution that can be represented as a reverse-adjoint sum of local, target-free Hermite mean-map defects evaluated on the frozen level-C forward state, without feeding the correction back into that state.
hypotheses.finite_width_arm: If those local defects cancel a genuine leading 1/n term, their relative RMS should scale approximately as 1/n and the corrected relative RMS may fall to O(1/n^2). This is a falsifier, not an assumption.
hypotheses.caution: Existing quadrature/coherence evidence reports low-degree retention changing much more slowly than 1/n (approximately 0.397 at n=64 L6, 0.359 at n=1024-real, 0.156 annealed), so clean 1/n scaling is not presumed.
hypotheses.null: The cheap reverse construction is only the ordinary first-order forward Duhamel sum with a small or misaligned local source; a non-equivalent exact full Hermite functional is rank/cost impossible at degree 5.

exact_operator.baseline: Run the level-C closed-loop ledger. At layer l let pre_l be its predicted pre-ReLU state, post_l its predicted post-ReLU state, and phi_l = Phi(mu_l/sigma_l). The candidate never changes pre_l, post_l, covariance, or cumulant state.
exact_operator.kappa5_closure: g5_hat = 5*g3*g4 - (40/9)*g3^3, using standardized g3 and g4 from pre_l.
exact_operator.column_definition: Cq = sigma*phi(mu/sigma)*He_{q-2}(-mu/sigma). Layer 1 has an exactly Gaussian input and therefore an exactly zero source.
exact_operator.forward_duhamel: For every source layer l, set v=s_l and for k=l+1..D apply v <- (v @ W_k) .* phi_k. Sum all endpoint v and add once to the unmodified level-C endpoint mean.
exact_operator.reverse_adjoint: J_k = W_k diag(phi_k). Define A_l = product_{k=l+1..D} J_k in forward order. The endpoint correction is sum_l s_l A_l. An implementation may accumulate this by forward source transport or exact small-n matrix products, but the two must agree.
exact_operator.onsager_interpretation: The s_l are local predicted mean-map defects and the adjoint sum is the perturbative final-functional/Onsager-loop correction. It is not claimed to be an exact full Hermite density expansion.
exact_operator.no_feedback_rule: No source, correction, truth residual, or adjusted endpoint may enter any future forward-state update.

frozen_networks.construction: For each seed draw five iid standard-normal 16x16 master matrices. The n=16 network uses all entries scaled by sqrt(2/16). The coupled n=8 network uses each top-left 8x8 block scaled by sqrt(2/8).
frozen_networks.matched_width_scaling_endpoint: depth 4, using the full n=8 network and the first four layers of its coupled n=16 network

algebraic_gates.ledger_reproduction: Captured baseline posts must agree with ledger_rig.run_ledger(..., 'C') to max relative error <= 1e-12.
algebraic_gates.K4_identity: The K4 endpoint must be bitwise identical to the baseline endpoint.
algebraic_gates.source_identity: At every non-Gaussian layer and ladder degree, the explicit source formula must agree to max relative error <= 1e-13 with the corresponding difference of analytic Hermite mean maps.
algebraic_gates.adjoint_parity: Forward Duhamel transport and explicit reverse matrix-adjoint products must agree to max relative error <= 1e-12.
algebraic_gates.equivalence_gate: Record, rather than obscure, that the compressed reverse operator is algebraically identical to first-order forward Duhamel for the same additive sources. Therefore reverse direction alone is not a new operator. Promotion requires the new target-free source ladder to pass every empirical gate; otherwise classify EQUIVALENT_EFFECT_CAPPED and close.
algebraic_gates.full_expansion_rank_gate: A genuinely non-equivalent exact scalar Hermite functional through total degree 5 requires at least binom(n+4,5) coefficients. At n=1024 this lower bound must be compared with the complete 2.2e12 FLOP budget before any full-expansion proposal.

empirical_gates.accuracy: For K12, baseline_MSE/corrected_MSE must be >=3.0 separately on all four frozen final endpoints, and its geometric-mean improvement must be >=3.0. No seed may be omitted.
empirical_gates.degree_ladder: Report K4, K5, K7, K9, K12. K12 must be the best aggregate rung; otherwise rank/degree selection fails because no target-free reason selects a lower rung.
empirical_gates.alignment: For K12, cosine(delta, truth-baseline) must be >=0.5 on every frozen final endpoint.
empirical_gates.nontriviality: For K12, endpoint correction RMS must be >=0.05 times baseline error RMS on at least three of four frozen final endpoints.
empirical_gates.stability: All quantities must be finite; K12 correction RMS <=4 times baseline error RMS on every endpoint; corrected MSE <=10 times baseline MSE; reference RMS standard error <=0.10 times corrected RMS error.
empirical_gates.finite_width_falsifier: At coupled depth 4, report relative correction RMS and corrected relative error RMS at n=8 and n=16. 1/n source evidence requires the median paired ratio delta_rel(n8)/delta_rel(n16) in [1.4,2.8]. O(1/n^2) residual evidence requires corrected_rel(n8)/corrected_rel(n16) in [2.8,5.6], equivalent to an MSE ratio in [7.84,31.36]. These scaling results are diagnostic and cannot rescue a failed >=3x endpoint gate.
empirical_gates.reference_noise: If a stability/noise gate fails, stop as INCONCLUSIVE_NOISE; do not increase samples unless a new receipt is written first.

width1024_depth16_cost_gate.cheap_operator_cost_pass_rule: total_extra_flops_upper_bound <= 1.0e9 and current host total plus this bound <=2.2e12
width1024_depth16_cost_gate.full_expansion_fail_rule: If the scalar degree-5 coefficient lower bound alone exceeds 2.2e12, the exact full-expansion arm fails before output multiplicity, layer transport, or arithmetic is counted.

terminal_logic.PASS_SMALL_N_ONLY: All algebraic, empirical, scaling-diagnostic reporting, stability, rank/degree, and cheap-cost gates pass. This still requires a separate preregistration before any development-target run.
terminal_logic.CLOSE_EQUIVALENT_EFFECT_CAPPED: Adjoint parity proves Duhamel equivalence and any accuracy/alignment/nontriviality/degree gate fails.
terminal_logic.CLOSE_RANK_COST_DICHOTOMY: The cheap compressed arm fails while the first non-equivalent exact functional exceeds the rank/cost gate.
terminal_logic.INCONCLUSIVE_NOISE: Only a frozen reference-noise gate fails.
terminal_logic.mandatory_stop: On any equivalence, rank, cost, stability, accuracy, or degree-ladder failure: persist the terminal receipt and stop without accessing development targets.
